DOP: nippesa nipphesa m. [ cf S. niṣpeṣa], grinding, rubbing; clashing together; one who rubs or grinds ; Sv 91, 31 (~o sīlaṃ etesan ti nippesikā; Sv-pṭ I 166, 15 : nippiṃsantī ti ~ā, ~ā yeva nippesikā) = Ps IV 134, 5 ; Vism-mhṭ [ Be ] I 38, 19 (gandhādayo viya lābhāya paresaṃ akkosanādinā nipisatī ti ~o); — ifc see vajira-.

[ S. niṣpinaṣṭi; cf also S. nipiṣṭa], rubs, grinds ; Vism-mhṭ [ Be ] I 38, 19 (gandhādayo viya lābhāya paresaṃ akkosanādinā ~atī ti nippeso); — part.pr. nipisamāna, nipiṃsamāna, mfn. , Ja III 207, 24 (Mittavindakaṃ … ~amānaṃ taṃ khuracakkaṃ bhassi, Be so; Ee nipiṃsamānaṃ; Ce, Se nippīḷiyamānaṃ); — absol. nipisitvā, nipiṃsitvā, Vism 29, 25 foll. (gandha-jātaṃ ~itvā gandhamagganā viya paraguṇe ~itvā vicuṇṇetvā esā lābhamagganā hoti, Be so; Ce nipiṃsitvā; Ee nipiṃsitvā … nippiṃsitvā …; Se nippiṃsitvā) = Nidd-a I 397, 23 ( Be, Se so; Ce, Ee piṃsitvā … nipiṃsitvā …) = Vibh-a 485, 22 foll. ( Be so; Ce, Se piṃsitvā … nippiṃsitvā; Ee piṃsetvā … nippisitvā …); — caus. pr. 3 sg. nippeseti [ S. niṣpeṣayati], rubs, crushes, grinds ; Vism 29, 25 (veḷupesikā viya abbhaṅgaṃ parassa guṇaṃ ~eti nipuñchati, Ce so; Be, Ee, Se veḷupesikāya) = Nidd-a I 397, 22 = Vibh-a 485, 21 .

DOP: nippesika m. [ cf nippesa], one who solicits gifts in an inappropriate way; (according to cts: one who grinds or scrapes away, who belittles or denies the good qualities of others for his own advantage) ; D I 8, 30 (te kuhakā ca honti lapakā ca nemittikā ca ~ā ca lābhena ca lābhaṃ nijigiṃsitāro; Sv 91, 31 : nippeso sīlaṃ etesan ti ~ā); A III 111, 26 (nemittiko ca ~o ca; Mp III 273, 15 : ~o ti nippesanakatāya samannāgato, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee nippiṃsanakathāya); — °- tā , f., abstr. [ cf BHS naiṣpeṣikatā, naiṣpeṣikatva], soliciting gifts in an inappropriate way; (according to cts: by grinding away, belittling or denying others’ good qualities) ; M III 75, 13 (kuhanā lapanā nemittakatā ~ā lābhena lābhaṃ nijigiṃsanatā) ≠ Ja V 253, 15´ ≠ Vism 16, 10 ; Vibh 353, 9 (pāpicchassa icchāpakatassa yā paresaṃ akkosanā vambhanā … avaṇṇahāriyā parapiṭṭhimaṃsikatā ayaṃ vuccati ~ā) quoted Vism 23, 23 (29, 27 : ayaṃ yasmā veḷupesikā viya abbhaṅgaṃ parassa guṇaṃ nippeseti nipuñchati yasmā vā gandhajātaṃ nipisitvā gandha-magganā viya paraguṇe nipisitvā vicuṇṇetvā esā lābhamagganā hoti tasmā ~ā ti vuccati).
NCP: pass. part. pr. mfn. one who solicits gifts in an inappropriate way; (according to commentaries : one who grinds or scrapes away, who belittles or denies the good qualities of others for his own advantage)
